meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多来源深度调研自动整理成带引用的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需针对复杂问题多方位查证并输出有证据的总结
copy.tagline_en: Automatically turn multi-source research into cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need multi-source research and evidence-backed summaries

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求做研究时,Claude 会先提出交付材料(PDF/DOCX),再并行派出多组探索与资料整理代理,覆盖代码库、网页、官方文档等;持续记录、按线索循环扩展搜索,用运行代码验证争议说法,最后产出带引用和图表、经视觉质检的综合报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-research”这个词,或明确要求“深度研究”“hyperdebate 研究”等研究任务时触发;普通提问、调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深度调研一下这个开源项目的安全现状
say.note: 会派出并行探索代理,并产出带引用的报告。

say.text: 启动 hyperdebate 研究,正反对辩这个技术选型
say.note: 会安排至少两个对立视角辩论争议点。

say.text: ulw-research:查证某库是否真的支持热更新
say.note: 会运行代码来验证,而不是只信文档。

howto.what_en: Proposes deliverables (PDF/DOCX); spawns parallel explore+librarian swarms over code/web/docs/OSS; journals live; EXPAND-loops on worker leads; verifies claims by running code; outputs a cited synthesis past a visual-QA gate.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit research demands: the word 'ulw-research' (/ or $ forms), ultradebate/hyperdebate, or an explicit deep-research request. Not for normal questions or debugging.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to deep-dive the security status of this open-source project.
say_en.note: Spawns parallel searches and produces a cited report.

say_en.text: Start a hyperdebate to argue this tech choice from both sides.
say_en.note: Runs at least two opposing perspectives on contested claims.

say_en.text: ulw-research: verify whether this library really supports hot reload.
say_en.note: Runs code to verify instead of trusting docs.
